div.div: حَاقِدٌ (A, L) and ↓ حَقِدٌ (Ham p. 516) [Bearing rancour, malevolence, malice, or spite; hiding enmity, and violent hatred, in the heart;] retaining, or holding fast, enmity in the heart, and watching for an opportunity to indulge it or exercise it [speedily]; applied to a man; (L;) and in like manner to a heart, as also ↓ مُحْتَقِدٌ . (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
